facts.text: I want reminders for my daily tasks.
I have a conference call at 3:00 PM on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
I have a yoga class at 4:30 PM on Tuesdays.
I like to sleep in on weekends until around 9:00 AM.
I want the reminders to not go off on Saturdays and Sundays.
I have meditation sessions on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays.
I want a reminder at 7:15 AM on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays to fit in a 10-minute meditation session before getting out of bed.
I want a reminder for my lunch break at 12:30 PM every day from Monday through Friday.
I want a reminder at 9:30 PM every day from Monday through Friday to start reading for at least 30 minutes before bed.
I want a reminder for my coffee break on Fridays at 3:00 PM to grab a coffee and take a short walk outside.
I want a reminder at 9:00 AM every Monday through Friday to start my most important tasks.

keyphrases: 10-minute meditation before getting out of bed
